items.t: Steering wheel may come loose
items.job: Install new steering wheel bolt and torque to spec
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel line O-rings may leak
items.job: Replace fuel line O-rings at the fuel rail connections
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Throttle may stick open
items.job: Replace throttle and speed control cables
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Engine may stall when slowing down
items.job: Reprogram engine computer with updated software
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: ABS module fire risk
items.job: Install fused ABS wiring harness or replace ABS module
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recalls. Check your VIN first. Full module replacement is the high end.

items.t: Front lower control arm can rust through
items.note: Price is per side. Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear liftgate latch may open in a crash
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Vehicle may not actually be in Park
items.job: Adjust or replace shift cable and shift interlock
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Electric power steering assist may cut out
items.note: Check your VIN for recall or extended coverage first.

items.t: Park may not hold the vehicle
items.job: Inspect and repair shift cable and bracket
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump module may crack and leak
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel line can split (do-not-drive recall)
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: 1.6L overheating and cracked head fire risk
items.note: Recall adds a coolant sensor and software. If the engine is ruined, a replacement costs much more.

items.t: Shifter cable can come loose
items.job: Install new shift cable bushing or cap
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Door may not latch
items.note: Price is per door. Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Coolant leaking into the cylinders
items.note: Ask a Ford dealer about warranty or goodwill help before paying for an engine.

items.t: Fuel pump may fail and stall the engine
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake hoses may rub and leak
items.job: Replace front brake hoses and bleed brakes
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Cracked fuel injector fire risk
items.note: Recall also adds a drain tube and software. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Oil separator housing may crack
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Hybrid engine failure can lead to fire
items.note: Recall adds fire-prevention fixes. A failed engine may be covered by warranty; check your VIN.

items.t: High-voltage battery cell defect
items.note: Recall often starts with a software update. Hybrid battery warranty may also apply; check your VIN.

items.t: Transmission may shift into Neutral
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear drive unit may lose oil and seize
items.note: Recall may only inspect and refill if no damage was done. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Loose transmission bolts may leak fluid
items.job: Tighten transmission bolts and refill fluid
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel delivery module may leak and stall
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear brake linings may be defective
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel injector O-ring support missing
items.job: Install injector O-ring supports and new seals
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Adaptive cruise may brake unexpectedly
items.job: Update radar and cruise control software
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Cylinder head plugs may leak oil
items.job: Replace or reseal cylinder head plugs
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake booster control unit may overheat
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. If the booster unit must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Park may not engage
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.
